marketing_description: The Milwaukee 3049-20 M12 FUEL Subcompact Impact Wrench features a POWERSTATE Brushless Motor and 4-Mode Drive Control for efficient fastening. With a 3/8 in square drive and 250 ft-lb fastening torque, this tool is suitable for a variety of applications. It operates at speeds up to 2700 RPM and impacts per minute up to 3200 ipm.
